name: Bases Card Wrap
changes: The plugin no longer keeps a closed cards view or a closed popout window in memory.
A theme or font change now resets the scrollbars of the wrap boxes in a popout window too.
tip: Open a base in cards view and run the command "Set card wrap for this view". Each view of each base keeps its own rule.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Card Wrap is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
